title: TutorTrace: A Dataset and Taxonomy for Classifying Learner Behavioral States during AI-Assisted Programming Education
abstract: arXiv:2608.26184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI programming tutors provide scalable support, yet lack the behavioral context human tutors rely on to adapt support to learners' needs. We present TutorTrace, a dataset and behavioral abstraction pipeline that makes learners' behavioral context visible and computable in real time from low-level IDE telemetry. Across four deployments in two introductory Python courses (N=480), TutorTrace captures approximately 180K telemetry events, 13,633 behavioral segments, and 27 continuously computed metrics. From this foundation, we derive a taxonomy of learner activity before the first AI query, between consecutive queries, and across the full session, enabling systems to respond not just to what learners say, but to what they have done leading up to the help-seeking moment. translated_title: TutorTrace：用于AI辅助编程教育中学习者行为状态分类的数据集与分类体系
translated_abstract: AI编程导师提供了可扩展的支持，但缺乏人类导师赖以根据学习者需求调整支持的行为背景。我们提出了TutorTrace，一个数据集和行为抽象管道，能够从低级IDE遥测数据中实时使学习者的行为背景可见且可计算。在两个入门Python课程的四次部署中（N=480），TutorTrace捕获了约18万条遥测事件、13,633个行为片段和27个连续计算的指标。基于此，我们推导出一个关于学习者在首次AI查询前、连续查询之间以及整个会话中的活动分类体系，使系统不仅能响应学习者所说的内容，还能响应他们在寻求帮助时刻之前所做的事情。在初步课堂评估中，行为感知提示与查询间隔中无独立工作的比例从50.0%降至20.7%相关。
tldr: 本文提出了TutorTrace数据集和行为分类体系，通过实时分析IDE遥测数据来捕捉学习者的行为背景，使AI编程导师能基于行为状态而非仅对话内容提供自适应支持。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TutorTrace, a dataset and behavioral taxonomy that leverages real-time IDE telemetry to capture learners' behavioral context, enabling AI programming tutors to adapt support based on actions rather than just dialogue.
